verdict.rationale: Brex's Accounting API, Webhooks API, and GL-coding automation claims (brex-docs-1, brex-docs-3, brex-docs-8, brex-docs-14, brex-intdir-1) suggest some real-time accounting sync and automated journal-entry-like features, but there is no evidence naming specific ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks) or confirming true bidirectional sync rather than one-way export/import. Missing for 10: named ERP integration partners, explicit bidirectional sync architecture details, and independent/hands-on confirmation that manual journal entries are eliminated.
